title: Machine learning and lipidomics select 17 metabolites for pancreatic cancer detection
summary: Greedy-algorithm and mass spectrum feature selection chose 17 lipid metabolites for a targeted LC-MS assay for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, studied in 1033 patients with PDAC. It reached 86.74% accuracy (AUC 0.9351) in a large external validation cohort and 85.00% accuracy (AUC 0.9389) in a prospective clinical cohort. Tissue single-cell sequencing, proteomics and mass spectrometry imaging showed alterations of selected lipids. A diagnostic biomarker study, not shown to be in clinical use.
ai_technology: Machine learning with greedy-algorithm feature selection of 17 lipid metabolites for a targeted LC-MS detection assay
organization: Peking University; Center for Life Sciences

evidence.tested: Large external validation cohort and a prospective clinical cohort; tissue omics analyses of selected lipids.
evidence.unknown: Performance in early-stage and screening populations and clinical benefit are not stated; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning selected the metabolite panel and classified samples for PDAC detection.
